shared_elements: relief carving on a slab-like upright surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright relief-carved slabs bearing anthropomorphic imagery with schematic incised detail, and both include disc-like round motifs and a headdress-like element on a head, but these are generic correspondences. A depicts a single massive frontal, near-sculptural figure with a broad head, pendant ornaments and a large chest disc, whereas B shows a narrative scene of multiple slender profile figures facing one another across an offering stand under a canopy, an entirely different compositional and figural convention.
